apps.description: Apps you have allowed to use Leafdesk on your behalf, for example AI assistants connected over MCP. They reach every workspace you are in.

profile.description: How you appear to others in every workspace, the email you sign in with, and deleting your account.
profile.heading: Profile
profile.pictureHelp: Shown next to your name in member lists, comments, mentions and on pages you have open. PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF; cropped to a square.
profile.name: Name
profile.nameHelp: Your full name or the name your team knows you by.

email.heading: Email
email.description: You sign in with this address, and emails from Leafdesk go to it.
email.mailOff: You sign in with this address. Changing it needs a confirmation email, and email isn't set up on this server; ask its administrator to set SMTP_URL.
email.pendingDescription: Open the link we sent to that address within {hours} hours to finish the change.
email.dialogBody: We'll send a link to the new address. Your email stays {email} until you open it.
email.sentBody: If {email} can be used, a confirmation link is on its way there. It works for {hours} hours.
email.unverifiedDescription: Verify your address so workspaces that allow your email domain can let you in.
email.unverifiedMailOff: Verifying needs an email, and email isn't set up on this server.
email.verifySent: A verification link is on its way to {email}.

password.heading: Password
password.title: Password
password.set: Sign in with your email address and this password.
password.notSetSocial: You sign in with {providers}. Set a password to also sign in with your email address.
password.revokeOthers: Sign out of all other sessions
password.revokeOthersHelp: Every other browser and device has to sign in again with the new password, and apps you connected (such as AI assistants) have to be connected again.
password.changedSignedOut: Password changed. Your other sessions are signed out and your connected apps disconnected.
password.setBody: After this you can also sign in with your email address and this password.
password.setDone: Password set. You can now sign in with your email address too.

proof.code: Code from your authenticator app, or a recovery code
proof.recent: You signed in a few minutes ago, which confirms it's you.
proof.stale: To confirm it's you, sign out and sign in again, then come back here within 10 minutes.

sessions.heading: Sessions
sessions.description: Browsers and devices signed in to your account. Sign out any you don't recognize, then change your password.
sessions.revokeOthersBody: {count, plural, one {# other session} other {# other sessions}} will be signed out, and pages open there stop syncing. This browser stays signed in.

delete.heading: Delete account
delete.title: Delete account
delete.description: Deletes your account for good. You can't undo it.
delete.dialogBody: You are signed out everywhere, connected apps lose access, and you leave every workspace. Pages you wrote in shared workspaces stay there; pages only you could manage pass to an owner.
delete.deletedList: Deleted with all their pages and files, since nobody else is in them:
delete.blockedBody: You are the only owner of workspaces other people are in. Make someone else an owner of each (Settings > Members), or remove the others, then delete your account.

confirmEmail.title: Confirm your new email address
confirmEmail.body: Your Leafdesk account will use {new} instead of {old}. From then on you sign in with the new address.
confirmEmail.invalidBody: It has expired, was used already, or a newer request replaced it. Ask for a new link from your account page.

errors.invalidCode: That code didn't work. Check it and try again.
errors.signInAgain: To confirm it's you, sign out and sign in again, then try within 10 minutes.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.passwordAlreadySet: Your account already has a password. Change it instead.
errors.noPassword: Your account has no password yet. Set one instead.
errors.mailDisabled: Email isn't set up on this server, so the address can't be confirmed.
errors.linkInvalid: This link doesn't work any more. Ask for a new one.
errors.emailTaken: Another account uses this address now.
errors.confirmationMismatch: Type your email address exactly to confirm.
errors.soleOwner: You are the only owner of {workspaces}. Make someone else an owner first.
errors.currentSession: Use Sign out in the menu to end this session.
errors.avatarType: Use a PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF image.
errors.avatarTooLarge: The picture is too large (2 MB at most).
errors.samePassword: Choose a password different from the old one.
errors.resetStepExpired: This step has expired. Sign in with your old password again.
